entities.name: Gerard Lake, 1st Viscount Lake
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gerard Lake, 1st Viscount Lake was a British general. He commanded British forces during the Irish Rebellion of 1798 and the Second Anglo-Maratha War. He later served as Commander-in-Chief of the military in British India.
